artifacts.name: build_parser
artifacts.description: Return the MAID CLI parser with long-option prefix abbreviation disabled for the root parser and all nested subcommand parsers; registered option spellings, defaults, and aliases are unchanged.

artifacts.name: main
artifacts.description: CLI entry point; abbreviated option spellings exit with argparse's usage error (SystemExit code 2) before any command handler runs.

artifacts.name: test_verify_rejects_manifest_option_abbreviation
artifacts.source_scenario: An agent runs the incident command shape `maid verify --require-plan-lock --require-red-evidence --manifest <file>` where verify defines --manifest-dir but not --manifest.

expected.behavior: Parsing exits with SystemExit code 2 and stderr names `--manifest`; the manifest file path is never accepted as a manifest directory.

artifacts.name: test_top_level_option_abbreviation_rejected
artifacts.source_scenario: A prefix spelling of a registered option is passed to a top-level subcommand, e.g. `validate --manifest-d`.

expected.behavior: Parsing exits with SystemExit code 2 instead of expanding the prefix to --manifest-dir.

artifacts.name: test_nested_subcommand_option_abbreviation_rejected
artifacts.source_scenario: Prefix spellings are passed to nested subcommand families, e.g. `plan lock <manifest> --no-r` and `manifest create <file> --goal <goal> --dry`.

expected.behavior: Nested parsers inherit the no-abbreviation behavior and exit with SystemExit code 2.

artifacts.name: test_full_option_spellings_still_parse
artifacts.source_scenario: Full option spellings for the same commands are used: `verify --manifest-dir`, `plan lock --no-run`, `test --manifest`.

expected.behavior: Full spellings parse to the same namespace values as before; disabling abbreviation does not change registered options.

artifacts.name: test_main_rejects_abbreviated_option_before_dispatch
artifacts.source_scenario: The CLI entry point receives the incident command shape end to end.

expected.behavior: main raises SystemExit with code 2 from argument parsing; no command handler output is produced.
